tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch7:7-13↗ prob:lie-group-bi-invariant-metric Let $G$ be a Lie group with a bi-invariant metric $g$. Show that the following formula holds whenever $X, Y, Z$ are left-invariant vector fields on $G$: \[ R(X,Y)Z = \frac{1}{4}[Z,[X,Y]]. \] \end{exercise}
